rows.Scope narrative:
## Per-coin attribution: what each coin contributed, and what joint basket exposure explains

**1 January-30 September 2026, all nine unchanged frozen strategies.** These explanatory diagnostics separate accounting contribution from statistical sensitivity. Strategy returns, Sharpe, turnover, drawdowns, baskets and decisions remain fixed. These factor diagnostics explain the same evaluation paths; they do not select a new winner or change the nine-case acceptance decisions.

The overview shows **annual alpha in percent per year**, estimate [95% CI]. Alpha is 365 times the daily arithmetic intercept, **not CAGR**. The BTC-only comparison uses its full-calendar HAC7 estimate; matched BTC and the joint model use the identical complete-case dates with calendar HAC27.
rows.Interpretation narrative: **How to read this.** The joint regression includes an intercept and all eight basket coins simultaneously. A conditional beta is sensitivity holding the other seven factors fixed; it is not a portfolio weight, a causal contribution or proof of market neutrality. R-squared is an in-sample descriptive fit. Comparing joint with matched BTC separates added factors from sample exclusions; the full-calendar BTC-only comparison also uses a different covariance convention.
rows.Methods narrative:
**Uncertainty and missingness.** Joint and matched BTC intervals are approximate marginal 95% normal-Wald intervals using Bartlett calendar HAC27 and n/(n-k) correction; HAC7 sensitivity is exported. Missing factor days are excluded from regressions only; gaps are not filled or compressed. The complete strategy and attribution calendars remain intact. Standardized condition >30 or any VIF >10 is a warning, not a reason to drop a coin. Some fits are sensitive to extreme days; high leverage/Cook's distance can coexist with modest collinearity. No event is removed and no model reselected.

**Per-coin accounting.** Gross contributions and positive allocated fees are both linked with prior **net** strategy NAV; net = gross - fees. Units are whole-period percentage points (pp) of initial capital, not standalone coin returns. The next pages retain all eight slots and their marginal net-contribution intervals.
rows.Companion narrative:
### Full precision, sensitivity and multiplicity

[Per-coin gross, fee and net attribution with all three confidence intervals](exports/basket_coin_attribution.csv) | [Joint alpha/betas, HAC7 sensitivity, global Holm243 p-values and Bonferroni243 intervals](exports/basket_joint_coefficients.csv) | [Joint model diagnostics and individual VIFs](exports/basket_joint_models.csv) | [Full-calendar BTC-only estimates and intervals](exports/basket_btc_only.csv) | [Matched BTC-only coefficients and intervals](exports/basket_matched_btc.csv) | [Regression calendar and exclusions](exports/basket_regression_calendar.csv).

Attribution uses **4,000 seeded, synchronized circular 28-day calendar-block draws** across all nine strategies and eight coins. Daily gross/fee vectors are resampled together and relinked using each draw's **new prior NAV**; signals, targets and trades are not regenerated and no block-boundary fee is invented. Any invalid draw makes the affected interval unavailable; none is silently dropped. Gross/fee intervals and invalid-draw counts remain in the CSV.

The coefficient correction spans **243 predeclared diagnostic slots: 27 joint alphas + 216 joint betas** across all three periods. Displayed intervals are marginal; approximate Bonferroni familywise intervals and Holm-adjusted p-values are exported. This corrects only that conditional coefficient family, **not the original universe, configuration, period or strategy-selection search**. Attribution intervals are marginal and not multiplicity-adjusted. No significance row changes the frozen shortlist or crowns a new winner. LUNA/LUNC is legacy Terra, not Terra 2.0; FTM/S and MATIC/POL retain the original economic slots.
